articles.title: Hiroshima Day — 6 August 1945 Atomic Bombing Commemorated
articles.title_hi: हिरोशिमा दिवस — 6 अगस्त 1945 परमाणु बमबारी की स्मृति
articles.summary: Hiroshima Day (6 August) marks the 1945 atomic bombing; the UN renewed calls for nuclear disarmament in August 2026.
articles.summary_hi: हिरोशिमा दिवस (6 अगस्त) 1945 परमाणु बमबारी की स्मृति है; UN ने अगस्त 2026 में nuclear disarmament का आह्वान renewed किया।
articles.content:
Hiroshima Day is observed on 6 August to commemorate the atomic bombing of Hiroshima in 1945 during World War II. Nagasaki Day follows on 9 August.

The Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons (NPT) entered into force in 1970. India is not an NPT signatory but supports global disarmament in a time-bound framework.

For IB ACIO: Hiroshima Day — 6 August; Nagasaki Day — 9 August; NPT — 1970.
articles.content_hi:
6 अगस्त — Hiroshima Day (1945)। 9 अगस्त — Nagasaki Day। NPT — 1970। India — NPT signatory नहीं।

IB ACIO: 6 Aug — याद रखें।

articles.question_hi: Hiroshima Day प्रतिवर्ष कब मनाया जाता है?
articles.explanation: Hiroshima Day is observed on 6 August.
articles.explanation_hi: हिरोशिमा दिवस 6 अगस्त को मनाया जाता है।

articles.moreInfo_hi: संबंधित: International Day against Nuclear Tests — 29 अगस्त।

articles.title: Lok Sabha Passes Taxation Bill Allowing UPI Merchant Charges
articles.title_hi: लोकसभा ने UPI merchant charges की अनुमति देने वाला Taxation Bill पारित किया
articles.summary: On 6 August 2026, Lok Sabha passed the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026, amending the Payment and Settlement Systems Act to permit charges on UPI.
articles.summary_hi: 6 अगस्त 2026 को लोकसभा ने Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026 पारित किया, Payment and Settlement Systems Act में UPI charges की अनुमति।
articles.content:
The Lok Sabha passed the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026 on 6 August, amending the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007. It authorises the government to permit banks to levy charges on UPI and other notified electronic payment modes.

RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra called MDR talks "premature". The Bill also eased data centre rules for AI infrastructure.

For IB ACIO: Bill passed 6 Aug 2026, Payment and Settlement Systems Act 2007, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman.
articles.content_hi:
Taxation Bill (6 Aug 2026): Payment and Settlement Systems Act 2007 amended। UPI charges — govt notification से। RBI Governor — Sanjay Malhotra।

IB ACIO: 6 Aug UPI Bill — याद रखें।
articles.question: The August 2026 Bill amending UPI charges primarily amends:
articles.question_hi: August 2026 UPI charges Bill मुख्यतः किसे amend करता है?
articles.explanation: The Bill amends the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007.
articles.explanation_hi: Bill Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007 को amend करता है।

articles.title: India-China 8-Point Boundary Consensus After SR Talks in Beijing
articles.title_hi: बीजिंग SR talks के बाद भारत-चीन 8-Point Boundary Consensus
articles.summary: NSA Ajit Doval and Wang Yi held the 25th SR talks; both sides agreed on early harvest in border delimitation and more LAC hotlines.
articles.summary_hi: NSA Ajit Doval और Wang Yi ने 25वें SR talks किए; early harvest in border delimitation और अधिक LAC hotlines पर सहमति।
articles.content:
India and China reached an 8-point consensus after the 25th round of Special Representatives talks in Beijing (August 2026). NSA Ajit Doval and Chinese FM Wang Yi co-chaired.

Outcomes include advancing "Early and Substantial Harvest" in boundary delimitation, two additional SHMC meeting points, two new border military hotlines in Eastern and Middle sectors, and reopening of Kailash-Manasarovar Yatra.

Next SR talks in India, 2027. LAC length cited: 3,488 km.

For IB ACIO: 25th SR round, Doval-Wang Yi, 8-point consensus, WMCC mechanism.
articles.content_hi:
25th SR talks: Doval-Wang Yi, Beijing (Aug 2026)। 8-point consensus। WMCC, SHMC hotlines। Next round — India 2027। LAC — 3,488 km।

IB ACIO: SR talks 2026 — याद रखें।

articles.explanation: NSA Ajit Doval and Chinese FM Wang Yi co-chaired the 25th SR talks.

articles.title: Supreme Court Directs Time-Bound Dowry Trial Completion
articles.title_hi: SC ने dowry trials के time-bound completion के निर्देश दिए
articles.summary: SC bench directed trial courts to frame charges in dowry cases within 60–90 days and HCs to review pending appeals periodically.
articles.summary_hi: SC bench ने dowry cases में charges 60–90 days में frame करने और HCs को pending appeals review करने का निर्देश दिया।
articles.content:
A Supreme Court bench of Justices Sanjay Karol and Augustine George Masih (August 2026) passed directions to expedite trials under the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

Trial courts must endeavour to frame charges within 60–90 days after chargesheet filing. High Courts must periodically review pending criminal appeals. Unnecessary adjournments to be discouraged.

For IB ACIO: Dowry Prohibition Act 1961, SC directions Aug 2026, 60–90 days for framing charges.
articles.content_hi:
Dowry Prohibition Act 1961। SC (Aug 2026): charges framing 60–90 days। HC periodic review।

IB ACIO: 1961 Act, 60-90 days — याद रखें।
articles.question: Under SC directions (August 2026), trial courts should frame charges in dowry cases within:
articles.question_hi: SC directions (Aug 2026) के अनुसार dowry cases में charges framing की अवधि:
articles.explanation: SC directed framing of charges within 60 to 90 days.
articles.explanation_hi: SC ने 60 से 90 days में charges frame करने का निर्देश दिया।
articles.moreInfo: Full directions also cited on 28 August 2026.

articles.title: MHA to Issue Border Zone Guidelines for Renewable Energy Projects
articles.title_hi: MHA border zone में renewable energy projects के लिए guidelines जारी करेगा
articles.summary: MHA prepared guidelines barring solar/wind projects within 1 km of LoC, LAC and IB; security clearance needed up to 50 km.
articles.summary_hi: MHA ने LoC, LAC, IB से 1 km के भीतर solar/wind projects पर ban और 50 km तक security clearance की guidelines तैयार की।
articles.content:
The Ministry of Home Affairs prepared national security guidelines (issued in detail on 8 August) restricting renewable energy projects near borders.

No projects within 1 km of LoC, LAC or IB. Security clearance for 1–50 km zone. MoD NOC for 1–20 km from IB. Restrictions on staff from Pakistan, Bangladesh and China without MHA permission.

For IB ACIO: MHA guidelines, 1 km ban, 50 km sensitive zone, MNRE routing.
articles.content_hi:
MHA: 1 km — no RE projects। 1-50 km — security clearance। 1-20 km IB — MoD NOC।

IB ACIO: 1 km ban — याद रखें।
articles.question: Under MHA border guidelines, no renewable energy project is permitted within:
articles.question_hi: MHA border guidelines के अनुसार RE projects कितनी दूरी पर banned हैं?
articles.explanation: Projects within 1 km of LoC, LAC or IB are banned.
articles.explanation_hi: LoC, LAC या IB से 1 km के भीतर projects banned हैं।

articles.title: Meri Mati Mera Desh 2.0 Campaign — 9 to 15 August 2026
articles.title_hi: Meri Mati Mera Desh 2.0 Campaign — 9 से 15 अगस्त 2026
articles.summary: Ministry of Culture launched Meri Mati Mera Desh 2.0 with Amrit Kalash yatras and Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam ahead of 80th Independence Day.
articles.summary_hi: संस्कृति मंत्रालय ने 80वें स्वतंत्रता दिवस से पहले Amrit Kalash yatras और Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam के साथ Meri Mati Mera Desh 2.0 शुरू किया।
articles.content:
Meri Mati Mera Desh 2.0 runs from 9–15 August 2026 under the Ministry of Culture, ahead of the 80th Independence Day. Activities include Amrit Kalash yatras carrying soil from villages, tree plantation under Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam, and pledge ceremonies.

Original campaign launched in 2023 under Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav. Complements Har Ghar Tiranga (13–15 August).

For IB ACIO: Meri Mati Mera Desh 2.0, Ministry of Culture, 9–15 Aug 2026.
articles.content_hi:
Meri Mati Mera Desh 2.0: 9-15 Aug 2026, Ministry of Culture। Amrit Kalash, Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam, Har Ghar Tiranga।

IB ACIO: Ministry of Culture — याद रखें।

articles.title: IMF Projects India as Third-Largest Economy by Nominal GDP
articles.title_hi: IMF ने India को nominal GDP में तीसरी सबसे बड़ी अर्थव्यवस्था projected किया
articles.summary: IMF August 2026 WEO projected India as 3rd largest economy by nominal GDP, surpassing Japan, with ~6.5% growth for FY2026-27.
articles.summary_hi: IMF August 2026 WEO ने India को nominal GDP में Japan से आगे 3rd largest economy projected किया, FY2026-27 growth ~6.5%।
articles.content:
The IMF World Economic Outlook (August 2026) projected India as the third-largest economy by nominal GDP after the US and China, having surpassed Japan. India retains fastest-growing major economy tag with growth near 6.5% for FY2026-27.

IMF headquarters: Washington, D.C. Key drivers: domestic consumption, services exports, PLI schemes.

For IB ACIO: IMF WEO Aug 2026, India 3rd nominal GDP, after US and China.
articles.content_hi:
IMF WEO (Aug 2026): India — 3rd largest (nominal GDP)। US, China के बाद। Growth ~6.5%। HQ — Washington DC।

IB ACIO: 3rd economy — याद रखें।

articles.title: Aditya-L1 Releases First Full-Year Solar Science Report
articles.title_hi: Aditya-L1 ने first full-year solar science report जारी की
articles.summary: ISRO Aditya-L1 released its first annual report from the Sun-Earth L1 point, aiding space weather forecasting.
articles.summary_hi: ISRO Aditya-L1 ने Sun-Earth L1 point से first annual report जारी की, space weather forecasting में सहायक।
articles.content:
ISRO Aditya-L1 mission released its first full-year science report in August 2026. Launched 2 September 2023 aboard PSLV-C57, it orbits the Sun-Earth L1 Lagrange point (~1.5 million km from Earth).

Payloads: VELC, SUIT, plasma analysers. Supports space weather forecasting for satellites and power grids.

For IB ACIO: Aditya-L1, launch 2 Sep 2023, PSLV-C57, L1 point.
articles.content_hi:
Aditya-L1: launch 2 Sep 2023, PSLV-C57, L1 point (1.5 mn km)। VELC, SUIT payloads।

IB ACIO: 2 Sep 2023 — याद रखें।

articles.question_hi: Aditya-L1 किस location की orbit में है?
articles.explanation: Aditya-L1 is at the Sun-Earth L1 Lagrange point.
articles.explanation_hi: Aditya-L1 Sun-Earth L1 Lagrange point पर है।

articles.moreInfo_hi: संबंधित: ISRO Chairman Dr V Narayanan।

articles.title: India Assumes IORA Chairmanship for 2026–28
articles.title_hi: भारत ने 2026–28 के लिए IORA Chairmanship संभाली
articles.summary: India assumed two-year IORA chairmanship prioritising maritime security, blue economy and disaster risk reduction.
articles.summary_hi: भारत ने maritime security, blue economy और disaster risk reduction को प्राथमिकता देते हुए दो वर्ष की IORA Chairmanship संभाली।
articles.content:
India assumed chairmanship of the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) for 2026–28 in August 2026. IORA has 23 member states, 11 dialogue partners; Secretariat in Ebene, Mauritius.

Established 1997 as IOR-ARC, renamed IORA in 2010. India priorities: maritime safety, trade, fisheries, climate resilience.

For IB ACIO: IORA chair India 2026–28, HQ Mauritius, 23 members, est. 1997.
articles.content_hi:
IORA: India chair 2026-28। HQ — Ebene, Mauritius। 23 members। Est. 1997, renamed 2010।

IB ACIO: IORA Mauritius — याद रखें।
articles.question: IORA Secretariat is located in:
articles.explanation: IORA Secretariat is in Ebene, Mauritius.
articles.explanation_hi: IORA Secretariat Ebene, Mauritius में है।

articles.content:
Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty reached the final of BWF China Open Super 1000 in Changzhou (August 2026). Former world No. 1 men's doubles pair.

Super 1000 is the highest BWF tier below World Championships and Olympics.

Satwik-Chirag: men's doubles, BWF China Open Super 1000 (Aug 2026), Changzhou।
